svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/return_loss/ - Return loss, device behind a measured cable
When it is seen: when the measurement file has the correction for a cable (correction): the
device is not on the VNA but at the end of a cable of which you already have the measurements.
What to draw: like image 4, but between the test lead and the device there is the measured
cable, drawn long and wavy to distinguish it from the test leads. P1 goes to the test lead, the
lead to the end A of the cable, the end B to the device.
Details: the calibration plane drawn at the end of the test lead, BEFORE the cable (a dashed
vertical line with the word CAL): it is the point that changes compared with image 4. The cable
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
